login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Use the username and password your hospital admin gave you.

errors.LOGIN_FAILED: Wrong username or password. After 5 failed tries the account is locked for 15 minutes.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.CSRF_FAILED: This page has expired. Reload it and try again.
errors.SESSION_EXPIRED: Your session has ended. Sign in again to continue.
errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Some details are not valid. Check the form and try again.
errors.PERMISSION_DENIED: You do not have permission to do this. Ask your hospital admin.
errors.NOT_FOUND: This record was not found. Reload the page and try again.
errors.CONFLICT: This already exists. Use a different code or name.
errors.SELF_CHANGE_NOT_ALLOWED: You cannot change your own roles, status or password here. Ask another admin.
errors.ROLE_NOT_ASSIGNABLE: One of the chosen roles cannot be given to staff of this hospital. Reload and choose again.
errors.DOCTOR_LOGIN_INVALID: This login cannot be linked. It must be an active doctor login that is not linked to another doctor.
errors.REFERENCE_INVALID: Something you chose is no longer active. Reload the page and choose again.
errors.RATE_DATE_INVALID: Choose a start date from today onwards, after the start of the latest rate.
errors.BED_OCCUPIED: A patient is in this bed or ward. Move or discharge the patient first.
errors.RATE_NOT_CANCELLABLE: This rate can no longer be cancelled: it has started, a later rate follows it, or it is already cancelled. Close this and open the history again.
errors.IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED: This form was already sent. Reload the page and check before trying again.
errors.IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS: This is still being saved. Wait a moment, then check before trying again.
errors.DUPLICATE_PATIENT: This Aadhaar or ABHA number belongs to a registered patient. Search for them instead of registering again.
errors.POSSIBLE_DUPLICATE: Someone matching these details was registered just now. Check the matches and try again.
errors.RATE_MISSING: This service has no rate for that date. Ask finance to set the rate, or choose another date.
errors.CHARGE_UNAVAILABLE: One of these charges is already on another bill. Reload the page and choose again.
errors.INVOICE_LOCKED: This bill has already been issued or discarded and cannot change. Reload the page to see it.
errors.SHIFT_REQUIRED: Open your cash shift before taking money.
errors.SHIFT_ALREADY_OPEN: You already have an open shift. Reload the page to see it.
errors.AMOUNT_EXCEEDS_DUE: This is more than is due or held. Reload the page and check the amounts.
errors.NO_DEPOSIT_HELD: No deposit is held for this patient now. Reload the page and check.
errors.BILL_NOT_ISSUED: Only an issued bill can take a payment. Issue the bill first.
errors.SHIFT_CLOSED: This shift is already closed. Reload the page to see it.
errors.network: Could not reach the server. Check the connection and try again.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Try again, and tell your admin if it keeps happening.

shell.searchPlaceholder: UHID, mobile or name. Press / to search

home.sessionEnds: You stay signed in until {time} at the latest, or until 15 minutes without activity.

comingSoon.body: This screen arrives with its phase 1 slice.

loadError.title: This screen could not load
loadError.body: Check the connection and try again. If it keeps happening, tell your admin.

common.name: Name
common.codeTaken: This code is already in use. Choose another.

validation.name: Enter 2 to 120 characters.
validation.code: Use 2 to 16 letters, digits or hyphens, starting with a letter or digit.
validation.username: Use 3 to 40 lowercase letters, digits, dots, underscores or hyphens.
validation.amount: Enter an amount in rupees, such as 500 or 1250.50.
validation.percent: Enter a tax rate from 0 to 100, such as 0, 5 or 18.
validation.email: Enter an email address, such as accounts@hospital.in.
validation.reason: Enter a reason of 3 to 200 characters.
validation.mobile: Enter a 10-digit mobile number, such as 98765 43210.

settings.title: Settings
settings.noSections: You do not have access to any settings. Ask your hospital admin if you need it.
settings.readOnly: You can view these details. Changes need permission from your hospital admin.

users.title: Staff users
users.description: Give each person their own login. Their roles decide what they can see and do.
users.search: Search staff by name or username
users.name: Name
users.createDescription: The person signs in with this username and the temporary password you set.
users.usernameHint: Lowercase, such as ravi.kumar. It cannot be changed later.
users.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. Give it to the person directly, never by message.
users.usernameTaken: This username is already taken. Choose another.
users.selfNote: You cannot change your own roles or status. Ask another admin.
users.activeHint: Turning this off signs the person out everywhere.
users.passwordDescription: This also unlocks the account and signs the person out everywhere.

departments.title: Departments
departments.description: Clinical departments. Every doctor belongs to one.
departments.codeHint: A short code, such as GENMED. It cannot be changed later.
departments.activeHint: An inactive department cannot be chosen for new doctors.

roomCategories.title: Room categories
roomCategories.description: Room types, such as General, Private and ICU. Room rent and nursing rates are set per category.
roomCategories.codeHint: A short code, such as PRIVATE. It cannot be changed later.
roomCategories.activeHint: An inactive category cannot be chosen for wards or rates.

doctors.title: Doctors
doctors.description: Doctors who see patients. Link a doctor to their login so they see their own queue.
doctors.fullNameHint: As it should print on prescriptions and bills, such as Dr Asha Rao.
doctors.loginHint: Only active staff users with the doctor role are listed.
doctors.visitingHint: A doctor who is not on the hospital staff.
doctors.activeHint: An inactive doctor gets no new appointments.

wards.title: Wards
wards.description: Wards and their beds. A ward takes its room rent from its room category.
wards.roomCategoryHint: Decides the room rent and nursing rates for beds in this ward.
wards.codeHint: A short code, such as GW. It cannot be changed later.
wards.activeHint: An inactive ward gets no new admissions.
wards.bedsDescription: Retire a bed that is no longer used. Free, cleaning and blocked are set on the bed board.
wards.noBeds: This ward has no beds yet.
wards.bedCodeTaken: This ward already has a bed with this code.

rates.title: Rates and fees
rates.description: Everything the hospital charges for, with its rate. A new rate starts on the date you choose. Past rates are kept and never changed.
rates.createDescription: Add the item first, then set its rate.
rates.codeHint: A short code, such as CONS-ASHA or ECG. It cannot be changed later.
rates.nameHint: As it should print on the bill.
rates.doctorHint: The consultation fee of one doctor.
rates.roomCategoryHint: The room rent or nursing charge of one room category.
rates.rateAfterCreate: After saving, use Change rate to set the amount and tax.
rates.activeHint: An inactive item cannot be charged.
rates.rateDescription: The new rate applies from the start date. The current rate ends the day before.
rates.noCurrentRate: This item has no rate yet.
rates.taxHint: Enter 0 if this service is not taxed.
rates.historyDescription: Every rate this item has had. Bills keep the rate that applied when the charge was made.
rates.cancelBody: The rate of {rate} from {date} will never apply, and the rate before it carries on. The record is kept.
rates.cancelReasonHint: Such as: entered the wrong amount.

hospital.title: Hospital profile
hospital.description: These details print on bills, receipts and discharge summaries.
hospital.codeHint: It starts every UHID and is set by DevMSR.
hospital.name: Hospital name

patients.title: Patients
patients.description: Find a patient before registering: most patients have been here before.
patients.searchHint: A UHID or just its number, a mobile number, a name, or an Aadhaar or ABHA number. At least 2 characters.
patients.typeToSearch: Type in the search box to find a patient.
patients.registerDescription: The patient gets a UHID when you save. Search first if they may have been here before.

form.fullNameHint: As on an ID card, such as Ravi Kumar.
form.ageHint: 0 to {max}. Use the date of birth for babies.
form.birthError: Enter the age in years, or a date of birth that is not in the future. Not both.
form.guardianError: Enter both the relation and the guardian name, or neither.
form.aadhaarHint: 12 digits. Stored encrypted; only the last 4 digits are ever shown.
form.aadhaarError: Check the Aadhaar number: 12 digits, and the last digit must match the others.
form.onRecord: On record: ending {last4}. Leave empty to keep it, or type a new number.

duplicates.blockedBody: The Aadhaar or ABHA number belongs to the patient below. Open their record instead of registering again.
duplicates.possibleTitle: Is this one of these patients?
duplicates.possibleBody: They share the mobile number, or the name and birth year. Open the record if it is the same person. If not, register a new patient: families often share one mobile.

desk.title: Billing
desk.description: Find a patient to add charges and prepare a bill, or finish a draft bill.

patient.title: Billing for {name}
patient.unbilled: {count, plural, =0 {No unbilled charges} one {# unbilled charge} other {# unbilled charges}}
patient.chosen: {count, plural, one {# charge} other {# charges}} chosen, {amount}

invoice.heading: Bill {number}
invoice.issueBody: The bill gets its number and is locked for good. Total {amount}. A correction after this needs a credit note.
invoice.discardBody: Its charges go back to unbilled, ready for another bill. The draft stays in the records as discarded.

document.held: {amount} of this deposit is still held

desk.title: Cash counter
desk.description: Open your shift, take payments and deposits, and close the shift with a cash count.
desk.findPatient: Find a patient to take money from

shift.openDescription: Count the cash in the drawer before you start. Money can be taken only during an open shift.
shift.cashError: Enter an amount in rupees, such as 2000 or 1250.50.
shift.nothingYet: Nothing taken in this shift yet.
shift.countedHint: Count every note and coin in the drawer.
shift.reasonError: Enter a reason of 3 to 200 characters.

form.amountError: Enter an amount in rupees, such as 500 or 1250.50.

dialogs.depositDescription: An advance held for the patient. It is set against bills later and is not revenue until then.
dialogs.applyDescription: Held: {held}. Due on this bill: {due}. No money changes hands.
dialogs.amountError: Enter an amount in rupees, such as 500 or 1250.50.

patient.title: Payments for {name}
patient.noShift: Your cash shift is not open, so money cannot be taken.

shifts.title: Cash shifts
shifts.description: Every cashier shift: the cash expected, the cash counted, and the reason for any difference.
